messages.subject: changing shannon index to stimated min_freq and max_freq in index sh (seewave)
parts:
Are any way to indicated or created arguments in seewave using index "sh" to define min_freq: minimum frequency in Hertz and max_freq, maximum frequency

example

a<-synth(f=8000,d=1,cf=2000,plot=FALSE)
speca<-spec(a,f=8000,at=0.5,plot=FALSE)

## Shannon spectral entropy
sh(speca,min_freq=1000,  max_freq=8000)
#Error in sh(speca, min_freq = 1000, max_freq = 8000) : 
  unused arguments (min_freq = 1000, max_freq = 8000)

Thanks.
